messages.author: 181bcebaf89c73b8
messages.subject: Error trying to install current develop branch
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to install the rstan develop branch from github. This
worked fine for me for 2.7.0 a couple of weeks ago, but I now get the
following error when running "make install":

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) :

Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! In file
included from fileafd368118f91.cpp:433:

In file included from
/private/var/folders/bs/_5d1ls2s2hzgyrcwxf3njrc00000gn/T/RtmpsHtWC7/Rinstaf075bff208e/rstan/include/rstan/rstaninc.hpp:3:

/private/var/folders/bs/_5d1ls2s2hzgyrcwxf3njrc00000gn/T/RtmpsHtWC7/Rinstaf075bff208e/rstan/include/rstan/stan_fit.hpp:98:10:
fatal error: 'stan/interface_callbacks/writer/filtered_values.hpp'
file not found


I'm on OS X 10.10.2, R 3.2.2. Any help much appreciated, thanks,

David.


--
David A. Knowles,
Stanford University.
E-mail: know...@gmail.com
Web: http://cs.stanford.edu/~davidknowles/

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error trying to install current develop branch
parts:
Hi David,

The fix is in the works.

I need to get this pull request working: https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/pull/213

That'll fix the incompatibility you're seeing. We're still working through development kinks after splitting our repos apart into submodules. 

I'll post back when it has been fixed on the develop branch. (If you're feeling brave, you could chance the branch that I'm working on.)



Daniel
